title: Implement ShoppingList Mutations
description: Add focused line-based mutation helpers for checklist items: toggle checked state, append unchecked items, and remove checklist lines while preserving all non-targeted Markdown byte-for-byte.
acceptance_criteria: `toggle(itemAt:)` flips only the bracket character on checklist lines and is a no-op for non-item lines.
`appendItem(_:)` appends exactly `- [ ] <itemText>\n`, inserting a newline first when needed.
`removeItem(atLine:)` removes the targeted checklist line including its trailing newline and is a no-op for non-item lines.
Untouched document content remains byte-identical after each mutation.

handoff_summary.completed: Implemented exact-range toggle mutation in `Packages/CookbookCore/Sources/CookbookCore/ShoppingList.swift` by mapping the regex capture for the checkbox marker back into the source text and replacing only that single-character range. Added a small `LineRecord` helper to translate per-line regex ranges into document ranges. Verified the file parses with `swiftc -parse`.
handoff_summary.risks: No behavioral tests were run per developer guardrails, so mutation behavior is syntax-checked but not execution-validated in this pass.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: Low. Changes are isolated to `ShoppingList.swift`; downstream agents touching the same file should preserve the new exact-range mutation helper.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Chose direct source-range replacement for `toggle(itemAt:)` instead of reconstructing the line so only the bracket marker is mutated and all other bytes in the document remain untouched.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Per guardrails, no test suite or test runner was executed. Validation was limited to `swiftc -parse Packages/CookbookCore/Sources/CookbookCore/ShoppingList.swift`.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: This pass does not provide runtime proof of the mutation semantics; that remains for the tester agent.

conflict_risks: Low. Changes are isolated to `ShoppingList.swift`; downstream agents touching the same file should preserve the new exact-range mutation helper.
